fact: Unnecessary impeding of Car 12 by Car 44 in turn 4.
offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 44 (Lewis Hamilton), the driver of Car 12 (Kimi Antonelli), team representatives and reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 44, although constantly checking his mirrors after being informed by the team about Car 12 closing in, slowly moved on to the racing line on the approach to Turn 4 and thereby unnecessarily impeded Car 12 which had to take evasive action. The driver of Car 44 apologized directly after realizing his mistake. The Stewards determined that, despite the more lenient approach to impeding in Free Practice, the impeding was unnecessary and that a Warning to the driver is warranted.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
